description: Use this when you need to see which OAuth apps currently hold access to this account, for example before revoking one. Read-only; requires auth. No inputs. Returns {object:"list", data:[{object:"oauth_grant", id, client_id, client_name, redirect_hosts, scope, resource, connected_at, last_refreshed_at, active_tokens}]}. One row per client that still has a usable token. An expired access token is included while its refresh token can still be used. client_name is empty when the client row is gone. redirect_hosts are hostnames only. Token hashes, refresh hashes, and client secrets are not returned. Newest last_refreshed_at first. An inbox-scoped key receives 403 permission_denied. A key without key_read receives 403 permission_denied. Fails with unauthorized.
name: cooper_list_oauth_grants
title: List connected apps
